style: 140 BPM, 5/4 time, British police and hospital TV drama underscore, orchestral-electronic hybrid, instrumental. A racing high piano figure circles in fives from the very first bar, bright, dry and relentless in the top two octaves; tight clipped electronic percussion, muted kick and ticking hats; shimmering high violins; deep sub synth bass. The middle register stays bare. Arc: full urgent drive at once, no intro; around 6 seconds the gear drops, the piano lets go and one held, glassy high string chord hangs, cold and still; around 10 seconds every instrument cuts out together on the same beat. Dead stop, silence after.
exclude: vocals, choir, humming, guitar, saxophone, fade-out, reverb tail, cheerful, comedic
title: Priority Lane score r6-uk-procedural-piano-motor
